course_description: This Surface Modeling course is designed to provide learners with a comprehensive understanding of creating high-quality freeform surfaces using industry-standard CAD techniques. The program focuses exclusively on surface modeling concepts, enabling students to develop accurate, smooth, and aesthetically refined models used in automotive, aerospace, consumer products, and industrial design.
